pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics, deep jing resonance and melancholic ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced in first 10 seconds)

넌 끝을 말하듯 등을 돌렸고
또 부딪힌 말, 식지 않은 마음이
울리지 못한 마음의 소리

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm, faint kkwaenggwari tension tick)

사랑인데, 사랑이 맞는데
왜 자꾸 너와 난 miss each other

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising slowly, ajaeng glissando, jing low resonance building, percussion layering gradually)

서로를 너무 사랑해서 아픈데
진심마저 벽이 되어 막아선 순간

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, kkwaenggwari sharp short hits for tension, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble, jing preparing low impact)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk + kkwaenggwari sharp attack + jing deep gong hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with soaring emotional melody)

시린 울림 too cold to ignore
사랑인데 왜 we keep missing
가슴속에 쌓인 진심들이
아직도 calling your name

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove with jing resonance, bright female vocal with deep emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring loneliness)

시린 울림 too cold to ignore
사랑인데 왜 we keep missing
가슴속에 쌓인 진심들이
아직도 calling your name

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding heavy emptiness, subtle jing sustain)

미안해… 사랑해… 그 말 한마디가
칼처럼 엇갈려 너를 찌른 걸까

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with kkwaenggwari sharp accents, ajaeng low stabs, taepyeongso short motifs)

Yo, we loved each other but words got lost in the dark
Your misunderstanding built up like a wall in my heart
Kkwaenggwari cuts sharp through the silence we share
Jing rings deep with the truth we couldn't bear
Bass drop heavy like the pain I can't release
I still love you, even when we miss each other’s peace

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers with kkwaenggwari tension hits, rising taepyeongso wail, jing deep resonance, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact with jing gong + kkwaenggwari sharp attack, taepyeongso lead stronger, full percussion explosion, female emotional adlib)

시린 울림 too cold to ignore
사랑인데 왜 we keep missing
가슴속에 쌓인 진심들이
아직도 calling your name

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful jing resonance and hook repetition)

시린 울림 too cold to ignore
사랑인데 왜 we keep missing
가슴속에 쌓인 진심들이
아직도 calling your name
시린 울림 too cold to ignore
사랑인데 왜 we keep missing
한 번만… 딱 한 번만
다시 사랑하자

[Outro]
(fade with long jing sustain, soft sogeum air and lingering gayageum harmonics, whispered male "다시 사랑하자... calling your name")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
